photos.desc: Marpissa muscosa ( Salticidae ) - (female), Arnhem - Schuytgraaf, the Netherlands
Biiig Jumping Spider 20-25mm big.. wow! The others, I have seen before, were only 5-7mm in size. After the photo session, the spider was released unharmed at the place, I found it.
